[[S&P 600]] component | company_slogan = | founded = 1938 | hq_location = [[Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania]] | key_people = Sanjay Chowbey, President and CEO{{cite news |last1=Napsha |first1=Joe |title=Kennametal CEO to retire; replacement named |url=https://triblive.com/local/westmoreland/kennametal-ceo-to-retire-replacement-named/ |access-date=29 November 2024 |publisher=Tribune-Review |date=15 March 2024}} | num_employees = approximately 10,000 worldwide | revenue = {{profit}}$2.4 billion [[United States dollar|USD]] | industry = [[Metals]] | products = aggregates, metalworking, abrasive flow products, cutting tools, metallurgy, mining equipment, woodworking, fluid handling | website = [http://www.kennametal.com/ www.kennametal.com] }} '''Kennametal, Inc.''' is an American manufacturer of high-performance [[Cutting tool (machining)|cutting tools]] and [[Component engineering|engineered components]] used in the aerospace, defense, transportation and oil and gas drilling industries. Its customer base is global.{{cite news |last1=Trombetta |first1=Peter |title=Rating Action: Moody's Ratings affirms Kennametal's Baa3 senior unsecured rating; outlook is stable |url=https://www.moodys.com |access-date=12 November 2024 |publisher=Moody's Ratings |date=11 September 2024}} [[File:Former office of Vanadium Alloys Steel Company.jpg|thumb|General office of predecessor firm Vanadium Alloys Steel; large lumps of coal in foreground]] ==History== Kennametal was founded in 1938 by Philip M. McKenna in the [[Latrobe, Pennsylvania]] area.{{cite news |title=Kennametal Inc: Company and People |url=https://www.barrons.com/market-data/stocks/kmt/company-people |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Barron's}}{{cite web|url=http://www.kennametal.com/en/about-us/company-profile.html|title=About Us|website=www.kennametal.com|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151215205028/http://www.kennametal.com/en/about-us/company-profile.html|archive-date=2015-12-15}} The company evolved from Vanadium Alloys Steel Company (VASCO), founded in 1910 by the McKenna family with its headquarters in [[Latrobe, Pennsylvania]]. While research director of VASCO, metallurgist Philip McKenna developed and received a patent for a tungsten-titanium carbide composition. McKenna formed Kennametal, Inc. for the purpose of marketing this alloy.{{cite web |last1=Derdak |first1=Thomas |title=Kennametal, Inc. |url=https://www.encyclopedia.com/books/politics-and-business-magazines/kennametal-inc-0 |website=Encyclopedia.com |access-date=10 November 2024}} The company's original flagship product, known as "Kennametal", was introduced in the late 1930s. It was described as "much harder than the hardest tool steel," which enabled high-rate steel cutting not possible previously.{{cite news |title=Kennametal Being Used in Many Ways |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/939768221/?match=1 |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Pittsburgh Post-Gazette |date=4 September 1946}} In July 1940, Kennametal of Canada Ltd. was organized for the purpose of "manufacturing Kennametal, the new steel cutting carbide, for Canada and British dominions."{{cite news |title=Kennametal of Canada Organized with Offices in Hamilton, Ontario. |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/939768221/?match=1 |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Toronto Star at Newspapers.com |date=2 July 1940}} In November 1940, United States Steel Export Company reached an agreement to sell Kennametal tools, tool blanks, drawing dies and other Kennametal products in foreign markets.{{cite news |title=Steel Export Unit to Sell Kennametal |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/pittsburgh-sun-telegraph-us-steel-export/158840950/ |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Pittsburgh Sun-Telegraph via Newspapers.com |date=12 November 1940}} During World War II, more than 50% of the artillery shells produced in the United States were machined with the Kennametal product.{{cite news |title=Research and Engineering Pace Company |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/latrobe-bulletin/158898666/ |access-date=12 November 2024 |publisher=Latrobe Bulletin via Newspapers.com |date=15 December 1952}} During this period the company developed a new type of anti-tank [[projectile]] made of [[tungsten]] with a hard [[carbide]] core.{{cite news |title=Plant Expands at Latrobe |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/pittsburgh-post-gazette/158843332/ |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Pittsburgh Post-Gazette via Newspapers.com |date=14 May 1945}} The company has expanded through acquisitions,{{cite web |title=Kennametal - M&A Summary and Business Overview |url=https://mergr.com/company/kennametal |website=Mergr |access-date=29 November 2024}}{{cite web |title=List of 6 Acquisitions by Kennametal |url=https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-kennametal/__PC4j67hp_EBIOXHJ27N-nn9HtfT1CNDwG6bOrljg_yQ#list-of-acquisitions |website=Tracxn |publisher=Tracxn Technologies Ltd. |access-date=29 November 2024}} including the purchase of [https://www.widia.com/us/en/home.html Widia Group] (2002, 188 million Euros){{Cite web |title=Kennametal Announces Completion of Widia Acquisition {{!}} Kennametal Inc. |url=https://investors.kennametal.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kennametal-announces-completion-widia-acquisition |access-date=2022-04-16 |website=investors.kennametal.com |language=en}} [https://www.extrudehone.com Extrude Hone Corp.] (2005, $137 million){{cite web |title=Kennametal, Inc. Steels Itself for M&A |url=https://www.themiddlemarket.com/news/kennametal-inc-steels-itself-for-m-a-MM44474 |website=The Mddle Market |publisher=Mergers and Acquisitions Report and SourceMedia, Inc. |access-date=29 November 2024}} and [[Allegheny Technologies|Allegheny Technologies']] tungsten materials unit (2013, $605 million).{{cite news |last1=Boselovic |first1=Len |title=Kennametal agrees to industry *Wheels and axles for [[rail transport]] *Custom engineering == Brands == [[File:Example of GTD Tap.jpg|thumb|WIDIA GTD Tap 1/16-27 NPTF 4F Taper Pipe Tap]] In 2009, Kennametal announced that they migrated all its current brands into two distinct portfolios: WIDIA Products Group and Kennametal Products Group.{{Cite web |title=Kennametal Launches WIDIA Products Group |url=https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/news/122733.html |access-date=2022-04-16 |website=www.kennametal.com |language=en-US}} === WIDIA Products Group === This group markets several brands: WIDIA, Hanita, and WIDIA GTD.{{Cite web |title=Services |url=https://www.widia.com/us/en/services.html |access-date=2022-04-16 |website=www.widia.com |language=en-US}} The GTD stands for Greenfield Tap & Die and was initially formed in 1912.{{Cite web |title=WIDIA GTD |url=https://www.widia.com/us/en/featured/widia-gtd.html |access-date=2022-04-16 |website=www.widia.com |language=en-US}} === Kennametal Products Group === Kennametal Products Group provides metalworking tools, metal powders, and wear-resistant coatings such as Conforma-Clad and [[Stellite]].{{Cite web |title=Products |url=https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/products.html |access-date=2022-04-16 |website=www.kennametal.com |language=en-US}} ==Financial Results and Credit Rating== Kennametal's fiscal year ends on June 30.{{cite news |title=Kennametal Inc. Financial Statements |url=https://www.wsj.com/market-data |access-date=1 March 2025 |publisher=Wall Street Journal}} For fiscal years 2020 through 2024, results ranged from a loss of $5.66 million to net income of $118.46 million. With respect to the 2020 loss, the company said: "The effects of COVID-19 were felt in every region during the quarter and created a challenging environment."{{cite web |title=Kennametal Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2020 Results |url=https://investors.kennametal.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kennametal-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2020-results |website=Kennametal corporate web site |access-date=11 November 2024}} The company returned to profitability in the following fiscal year. In September 2024, [[Moody's Ratings]] affirmed Kennametal's Baa3 credit rating, and opined that the outlook for the rating was "stable."{{cite news |title=Moody's Investors Service affirms Kennametal at "Baa3" (LT- local currency credit rating); outlook stable |url=https://cbonds.com/news/3059261/ |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=CBonds}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="margin-right:1em; float:center" |+ '''Net Income (Loss)''' |- !
